site_name: Victoria Recreation Ground, Public Conveniences Near Entrance To St Mary's Road
description: Change of use of public convenience to sale of food and drink (Class E)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The opening hours of the use to which this permission relates shall be limited to 0700 to 1800 Monday to Sunday/ Bank Holidays.Reason : to ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the Core Strategy 2012

Notwithstanding Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 ( as amended) ( or any Order revoking  and reenacting that Order with or without modification), the premises shall only be used for the purposes specified in the application documents and for no other purposes whatsoever (including any other purposes falling within Class E of the Schedule  to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 ( or any provision equivalent to that class in any Order revoking and reenacting that Order with or without modification.Reason : the acceptability of the development is highly dependent  upon the exact nature of the use of the site and other uses, whether within the same use class or permitted by the General Permitted Development Order, are unlikely to be acceptable in planning terms.

Details of proposed refuse and recycling facilities shall be provided prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates and shall be permanently  retained thereafter. The developer and/ or their successors in title shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development are either stores within these facilities or internally within the building (s) on the application site, and that no refuse or recycling material is stored or placed for collection on the public highway except on the day of collection.Reason : to ensure proper waste management in the interests of the character and appearance of the area and the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy SI17 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and MD10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Fire Safety Statement  ( dated March 2025) and thereafter maintainedReason : in the interest of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 of the London Plan 2021

The site and building works required to implement the development shall be only carried out between the hours of 08.00 and 18.00 Mondays to Fridays and between 08.00 and 13.00 on Saturdays and not at all on Bank Holidays and Sundays.Reason : to ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the Core Strategy 2012
